text: The purpose of this report is to advise that the City Manager will be submitting a report to City Council for its meeting on May 21, 22, and 23, 2025, to respond to MM29.11: Taking a Stand to Protect Ontario Place and Our City’s Public Waterfront, which requested staff to report to the next meeting of City Council with a status update on all City activities related to the Therme spa project.
City Council on May 21 and 22, 2025, received the Item for information.
